text:
Ava Chen: Ok folks — I uploaded a concise launch brief we can hand to field and use on the webinar sign-up page. It focuses on secure deployment modes, SLA highlights, and the benchmark narrative for cost/latency. Link: https://docs.google.com/enterprise-brief-draft :point_right:

Marco Diaz: on it — will skim and add a TL;DR for sales. Can you call out the typical latency numbers we want to quote?

Ava Chen: yes — recommend quoting 99th p95 numbers from the benchmark suite (private vs hosted vs dedicated). Example line: "p95 token latency: Hosted: 230ms, Dedicated: 180ms, Private (on-prem optimized): 210ms" — that keeps expectations clear.

Priya Nair: Suggest we add a short security bulleted section up top: encryption at-rest & in-transit, KMS/HSM integrations, audit logs, SOC2 mention. Sales ops always asks for that first.

Sam Patel: +1. Also add a one-sentence fallback/availability note: "auto-fallback to regional capacity with transparent routing to preserve SLA" — helps product folks when customers ask about graceful degradation.

Jasmine Li: I drafted two headline options for the launch post. Option A focuses on reliability ("Predictable LLM inference, everywhere"); Option B focuses on economics ("Cut inference unit cost without trading quality"). Which do we want for enterprise webinar?

Marco Diaz: For enterprise webinar, reliability/security wins. We can A/B test the social post later. Jasmine, can you put both headlines in the doc and mark recommended placement?

Ava Chen: done. Also I added a short inbound-routing rule proposal so field gets consistent leads. Please review: 
```
if lead.industry in ["finance","healthcare"]:
  route_to = "enterprise-sales"
elif lead.sla == "SLA-required":
  route_to = "solutions-architects"
else:
  route_to = "growth-sales"
```
We want engineering to own validation of tags, but marketing needs this first-pass.

Priya Nair: That looks good. Add a fallback to "platform-ops" for infra-specific questions. Also include tracking tag: campaign=secure-serving-may

Sam Patel: Quick note on webinar content flow: 1) Why deployment mode matters (3 slides), 2) Live benchmark walk-through (5 mins), 3) Security & compliance (3 slides), 4) Customer Q&A + field handoff. Keep live demo simple — show failover to Dedicated.

Jasmine Li: I drafted a 90s benchmark narrative for the webinar opening — shareable as a 1-paragraph soundbite for press: "In our tests across realistic prompt mixes, Dedicated configs reduced token unit cost by ~22% at steady throughput while improving p95 latency by ~18% compared to baseline hosted configurations — enabling predictable SLAs for production apps." Want me to soften or keep numbers?

Ava Chen: Keep numbers but add "typical" qualifier. Add a footnote link to the full benchmark deck. Marco, Priya — any legal review needed for public claims?

Marco Diaz: I'll ping legal. If they ask for source data, we should be ready to provide anonymized test harness and configs. I'll prepare that pack.

Priya Nair: For the sales one-pager, include three quick decision prompts: "Need strict data isolation? -> Private. Need committed throughput & lowest variance? -> Dedicated. Want fastest time-to-value? -> Hosted." Small flowchart style.

Ava Chen: Perfect. Also need one-sentence email copy for webinar follow-up that the SDRs can use. Draft below — please tweak: 
"Thanks for joining — here’s the brief on secure inference options (Private/Dedicated/Hosted), the benchmark deck, and next steps to evaluate Redwood for your SLOs: [link]"

Jasmine Li: Edited to: "Thanks for joining — here’s a concise brief on secure inference options (Private, Dedicated, Hosted), the benchmark deck, and next steps to trial Redwood with SLA targets: [link]"

Sam Patel: Love it. Last ask: can we get a one-slide cheat sheet for field that lists common objections + suggested responses (cost, compliance, uptime)? I can draft and drop into the folder.

Ava Chen: Yes please — drop by EOD. Also tagging LaunchBot to create a calendar invite for the webinar dry-run.

LaunchBot: Created calendar event: "Enterprise launch dry-run" on 2026-04-08 10:00 PT. Attendees: Ava Chen, Marco Diaz, Priya Nair, Sam Patel, Jasmine Li. Reminder set 24h before. :calendar:
